descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii financiare
Altex, is looking for a Senior-Level Dynamics 365 CRM Developer to join our team and support the development and enhancement of our Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement platform. You'll work closely with senior developers and solution architects to design, develop, and maintain customisations, integrations, and extensions for Dynamics 365 CRM — a great opportunity to expand your expertise across the Power Platform and Azure ecosystem.
 What you'll do
Design, develop, and maintain custom plugins, workflows, and business logic within D365 CE
Build and maintain Custom APIs and service endpoints for integration scenarios
Develop integrations between D365 CRM and external systems using Azure (Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus)
Implement solutions across Power Apps (model-driven and canvas), Power Automate, and Dataverse
Translate functional designs into technical specifications together with architects and functional consultants
Perform unit testing, debugging, and troubleshooting of custom code and integrations
Support data migration, UAT, deployment, and post-go-live stabilisation
Maintain technical documentation and participate in code reviews
 What we're looking for
5+ years of hands-on development experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM / CE and Power Platform
Experience with the D365 Customer Service & Customer Insights (Journeys & Data) module is considered a strong plus
Proven experience developing Custom APIs and custom service endpoints within Dynamics 365
Strong knowledge of the Dynamics 365 CE SDK, plugin development, and custom workflow activities
Solid understanding of the Dataverse data model, security model, and solution architecture
Hands-on experience with Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse
Experience with Azure services used for CRM integrations (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management)
Strong C#, .NET, and JavaScript development skills
Familiarity with Azure DevOps and Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) for Dynamics 365
Good understanding of Dynamics 365 security roles, business units, and access management
Strong analytical thinking, debugging, and problem-solving skills
Good communication skills and ability to work closely with functional and architecture teams
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
Ownership mindset and attention to quality
 Nice to have
Experience with D365 Contact Center / Omnichannel
Power Apps Component Framework (PCF)
Copilot Studio, AI Builder, or Azure AI Services
Certifications such as PL-400, MB-230, or MB-210
 Application Process
Application review period: by October 28. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Technical interview with selected candidates.
Final interview.
 Required Application Documents
CV.
Cover letter explaining your motivation and the value you would bring to the role. Please mention your academic degree.
Employment references (considered an advantage).
 Note: We reserve the right to proceed only with candidates who demonstrate integrity and professionalism. By applying, you confirm that you do not have a criminal record.
